correctness.rationale: Every matching with a rung has paired horizontal edges in both rows: successive intervals between rungs have identical even path components, so row-pairs are forced. Since rung 0 is removed and n is odd, each perfect matching covers column 0 by the pair H+ to column1 or H− to column n−1; no rungless or mixed cover exists. Facet-generated subcomplexes A,B are cones on a common required edge. A face in A∩B cannot touch columns 0,1,n−1; remaining chosen edges correspond to nonoverlapping allowed interior tiles (vertical rungs or paired horizontals), extendible to the n−3 straight ladder and conversely extendible under H±. Thus A∩B exactly equals P(L_{n−3}) as a simplicial complex, not just homologically. For even straight m, first-column rung/horizontal cones intersect in P(L_{m−2}), with base P(L_2)=two disjoint full-matching simplices, hence P(L_{2j})~S^{j−1}; n=3 gives two disjoint H± simplices~S⁰. Simplicial homotopy pushout then gives S^{(n−3)/2} integrally. Explicit independent exact matching enumeration n=3,5,7,9 produced 2,6,16,42 complete matchings and exact intersection face counts 1,7,61,547. Finite checks corroborate but are not the general proof.
